sources.title: One Meter Topobathymetric Digital Elevation Model for Majuro Atoll, Republic of the Marshall Islands, 1944 to 2016
sources.spatialResolution: 1 meter grid; checked raster is 46,227 by 23,813 cells
sources.verticalDatum: Local Mean Sea Level after source-datum adjustment; horizontal CRS ITRF2008 / UTM zone 59N
sources.uncertainty: Published validation reports land RMSE 0.197 m, Landsat-8-derived bathymetry RMSE 1.066 m, and WorldView-3-derived bathymetry RMSE 1.112 m; uncertainty varies by source region and is not a per-cell field.

sources.title: Inundation Exposure Assessment for Majuro Atoll, Republic of the Marshall Islands
sources.spatialResolution: 1 meter scenario grids, 39,730 by 12,715 cells for the selected 30-inch layers
sources.verticalDatum: Water level 0.762 m above Mean Higher High Water, derived from the ITRF2008 / UTM zone 59N TBDEM and local vertical transformations
sources.uncertainty: Cumulative vertical uncertainty is 0.192 m RMSE. The selected 30-inch increment is supportable at 95% confidence; its probability grid represents 750 Monte Carlo DEM realizations with values from zero through one.

sources.title: Ground-water resources of the Laura area, Majuro Atoll, Marshall Islands
sources.spatialResolution: Monitoring wells and test holes; machine-readable coordinates UNAVAILABLE
sources.uncertainty: Report-level estimates and observations; machine-readable uncertainty surface UNAVAILABLE

sources.title: Marshall Islands Regional 5 km Bleaching Heat Stress Maps and Gauges, Version 3.1
sources.sourcePeriod: near-real-time observations and weekly outlooks; snapshot date required at acquisition
sources.spatialResolution: 5 km satellite products; outlook source grid 0.5 degree
sources.uncertainty: Regional gauges use a 90th-percentile aggregation; pixel-level and forecast uncertainty require product documentation review.

layers.uncertainty: Use source-specific land and bathymetric validation; never apply one RMSE to all cells without metadata support.
layers.limitation: A multi-date composite is not a single-date surface, some northern islands are excluded, and the approximately 10 m canary derivative is not the authoritative 1 m raster.

layers.uncertainty: Selected 30-inch marine-inundation scenario uses the published 0.192 m cumulative vertical RMSE and a separate zero-to-one probability surface.
layers.observationOrScenarioDate: 2016 source surface; 0.762 m scenario above MHHW; analysis 2018; published 2019
layers.limitation: This is a static-water scenario with hydrologic connectivity, not an observed flood, forecast, engineering design surface, or present condition.
Reference supports context only; a redistributable, dated spatial dataset has not been identified.
No authoritative redistributable atoll-scale infrastructure source was established; local and regional review is required.

layers.uncertainty: Threshold and source-date sensitivity must be quantified before use.
layers.limitation: A shoreline derived from a composite elevation model is not a current legal or observed shoreline.
Heat-stress station regions do not provide an atoll-scale benthic reef polygon, and no NOAA raster was downloaded for this canary.

layers.uncertainty: Retain product version, daily source date, aggregation method, and forecast/observation distinction.
layers.limitation: Five-kilometer fields cannot support one-meter atoll claims, and no NOAA raster was downloaded or rendered for this canary.

preparedEvidence.transformation: GDAL 3.11.5 average resampling from the 46,227 by 23,813 Float32 source to 4,623 by 2,381 cells; source ITRF2008 / UTM zone 59N affine grid, LMSL heights, Float32 values, and NoData sentinel retained.
GDAL 3.11.5 nearest-neighbor resampling of the producer-defined zero/one 30-inch marine-inundation grid from 39,730 by 12,715 to 3,973 by 1,272 cells; source CRS and NoData retained.
GDAL 3.11.5 average resampling of the zero-to-one 30-inch Monte Carlo probability grid from 39,730 by 12,715 Float32 cells to 3,973 by 1,272 cells; source CRS and NoData retained.

contextInput.transformation: ImageMagick 7.1.2-27 contain-free exact resize to 700 by 394 pixels, 8-bit sRGB, stripped metadata, and deterministic PNG time/date exclusion from the Stage 14 authoritative full raster.
